claims: The 98th Academy Awards honor films from 2025.
The 98th Academy Awards will be held on March 15, 2026.
Sinners has 16 nominations for the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another has 13 nominations for the 98th Academy Awards.
Sentimental Value has 9 nominations for the 98th Academy Awards.
The Best Picture nominees for the 98th Academy Awards include Sinners, One Battle After Another, Sentimental Value, Hamnet, Marty Supreme, Frankenstein, Bugonia.

The Best Actor nominees for the 98th Academy Awards are Timothée Chalamet (Marty Supreme), Leonardo DiCaprio (One Battle After Another), Michael B. Jordan (Sinners), Wagner Moura (The Secret Agent), Ethan Hawke (Blue Moon).

The Best Actress nominees for the 98th Academy Awards are Jessie Buckley (Hamnet), Emma Stone (Bugonia), Renate Reinsve (Sentimental Value), Kate Hudson (Song Sung Blue), Rose Byrne (If I Had Legs I'd Kick You).

The Best Director nominees for the 98th Academy Awards are Ryan Coogler (Sinners), Paul Thomas Anderson (One Battle After Another), Chloé Zhao (Hamnet), Yorgos Lanthimos (Bugonia), Joachim Trier (Sentimental Value).

The Best Supporting Actor nominees for the 98th Academy Awards are Sean Penn (One Battle After Another), Stellan Skarsgård (Sentimental Value), Benicio Del Toro (One Battle After Another), Jacob Elordi (Frankenstein), Delroy Lindo (Sinners).

The Best Supporting Actress nominees for the 98th Academy Awards are Elle Fanning (Sentimental Value), Wunmi Mosaku (Sinners), Teyana Taylor (One Battle After Another), Amy Madigan (Weapons), Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas (Sentimental Value).
The Best Animated Feature nominees for the 98th Academy Awards are Zootopia 2, Elio, KPop Demon Hunters, Arco.
F1 was nominated for Best Picture for the 98th Academy Awards.
Weapons was not nominated for Best Picture for the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners broke the record for most nominations with 16 nominations for the 98th Academy Awards.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony takes place at the Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood.
